answer: Proof of Stake functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital as a beacon of their commitment. This mechanism acts as a bridge between digital identity and real-world resource scarcity, forcing attackers to commit substantial wealth to acquire influence. The cost of an attack flows like a river of liquidated capital, ensuring that the expense of sustaining multiple fake personas remains prohibitively high compared to the potential gain from disrupting the network.
